monito.name: Monito del Monte
monito.fact: Unique marsupial from the Valdivian forests. Considered a living fossil.

araucaria.name: Araucaria Araucana
araucaria.fact: Ancient tree sacred to the Mapuche people. Its seeds (piñones) are ancestral food.

woodpecker.name: Magellanic Woodpecker
woodpecker.fact: The largest woodpecker in South America. Inhabits native forests of Chile and Argentina.

frog.name: Darwin's Frog
frog.fact: Endemic species that incubates its young in its mouth. Endangered.

fern.name: Giant Fern
fern.fact: Found in both Valdivian and Amazon rainforests. Can reach 5 meters tall.

orchid.name: Native Orchid
orchid.fact: Over 3,000 species in LATAM rainforests. An indicator of ecosystem health.

story1.title: Rediscovering endangered native species

story3.title: Protecting local watersheds and ecosystems
story3.desc: Educational communities created floating microcontroller buoys to alert neighbors of changes in river water quality.

rutas.title: Four lessons already written
rutas.lead: Pick one and start. Nothing to configure and nothing to wait for: they are written, they cover several grades at once, and they print.
rutas.draftNotice: These four routes were written with the curriculum and the territory in hand, but no classroom teacher has reviewed them yet. Use them and tell us what breaks.
rutas.drivingQuestion: The question the route rests on
rutas.postureNote: The younger grades walk the place and gather the data; the older ones use it to hold something up in front of an adult. Each in their own role, and needing each other.
rutas.mapuzugunNotice: Terms in the Azümchefe writing system, not yet validated by a speaker. Check them with your school’s traditional educator before printing. What the community knows belongs to the community: it is not collected or published without their permission.
rutas.printLead: Tick what you need on paper. Each one prints on its own sheet so you can hand them out.
rutas.printNote: The full lesson for you always prints, further down. This is what goes in your pocket and into the students’ hands.
rutas.docFieldHelp: One per grade. With blank rows to fill in at the stream.
rutas.docGuideHelp: One per grade. The exercises, with room to work.
rutas.docLetterHelp: With the tear-off consent slip for the outing.
rutas.docProductHelp: What they deliver, to whom, and who did what.
rutas.drawThePlace: Draw the place where you measured, with what you see around it:
rutas.letterBody: For {{weeks}} weeks the class will be working on this question: “{{question}}”. To answer it we need to go out to {{place}} and take measurements there. It is not an outing: they arrive knowing what to measure, because we practise it in the classroom first.
rutas.letterDeliver: When they finish, the class delivers their work to: {{to}}. You are invited to see it.
rutas.letterConsent: Cut off and return this part signed
rutas.productAnswer: The class answer to the question, with their numbers:
rutas.productReminder: Someone outside the school reads this. The numbers have to be right because somebody will use them, not because the teacher checks them.
rutas.customize: Fit the route to your school
rutas.customizeEmpty: Not adjusted yet. Tap to add your school, your grades and your place.
rutas.customizeLead: The route is the same in every school. This is what changes in yours, and it is what gets printed.
rutas.gradesInRoom: Grades you have in the room
rutas.gradesHelp: Only the sheets for the grades you leave ticked get printed.
rutas.gradesNone: With no grades ticked there is nothing to print. Tick at least one.
rutas.outingDateHelp: It goes in the letter to families.
rutas.teacherHelp: Signs the consent slip for the outing.
rutas.recipientHelp: The route suggests one. Change it for whoever it is in your community.
rutas.savedHere: This is saved on this device. No account and no internet needed.
rutas.docSpecies: What has been seen around here
rutas.docSpeciesHelp: The iNaturalist list, with boxes to tick what they find.
rutas.speciesIntro: Mark an X next to what you find today. These species have already been recorded near your school.
rutas.speciesNotListed: What we found and is NOT on the list:
rutas.speciesSource: iNaturalist list, confirmed observations within 10 km. Anything not shown here is worth uploading.

natura.title: What has been seen around here
natura.found: {{count}} species recorded within {{km}} km, most seen first.
natura.empty: No confirmed observations within {{km}} km of here. That says something too: almost nobody has been recording in your area, and what the class finds may be new.
natura.timeout: The request took too long. It is usually the signal. Try again on a better connection.
natura.failed: It could not be checked right now ({{detail}}). The lesson works fine without this list.
natura.denied: You did not grant location permission. You can enable it in the browser and try again.
natura.noLocation: The location could not be obtained. Try outdoors or with a better signal.
natura.contribute: Whatever the class finds that is not on this list, have them upload it to iNaturalist. Rural areas have very few records: their observations are genuinely new data, not an exercise.
natura.savedOffline: Saved on this device: it works without signal now.

bio.title: What lives here
bio.notInOurListHelp: They are not in our reference list, which is deliberately short. It does not mean they are not native: it means we cannot tell you anything about them yet.
bio.empty: No records within {{km}} km of here. Try a wider radius. And if nothing shows up either, that is already data: almost nobody has been recording in your area.
bio.partial: Only one of the two sources answered. {{fuente}} is missing, so the list is incomplete.
bio.bothFailed: Neither source answered. It is usually the signal. The lesson works fine without this.
bio.savedOffline: saved on this device, it works without signal now
bio.notice: The Mapuzugun names are not yet validated by a speaker, and the conservation status must be checked against the current Chilean species classification regulation.
bio.pickPlaceLead: A stream, a forest, a road cut. Then we tell you what has been recorded there.
bio.noPlaces: The query worked but returned no places. The table may be empty, or their coordinates may be unreadable.
bio.loadFailed: The places could not be loaded from the database. Detail: {{detail}}
